rows.label: BGCA's advocacy for public funding of Clubs, booked in its programme lines, 2025 (US$)
rows.explainer: Our judgment: BGCA's Form 990 for 2024 reports $603,556 of lobbying ('federal lobbying payments, state lobbying payments, government relations dept costs', Schedule C Part II-B, https://www.bgca.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Public-Disclosure-Copy-BGCA-2024-990.pdf, PDF p. 125); its wider advocacy (support for the Clubs' state alliances, advocacy training for Club leaders, Capitol Hill days, public-funding staff) is booked in the two programme lines. About $3 million, from $1 million (little beyond the lobbying) to $8 million. Taken out of the Clubs model's cost per member; its result is the model's adv_value_share.
